# Swap the model provider without rewriting the agent

Agent applications should be able to change between OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, OpenRouter, Groq, and Ollama without moving provider-specific logic into the task, runtime, tools, or result handling.

## Audience

JavaScript and TypeScript developers who want one portable agent path across hosted and local model providers

## Commands

```bash
npm install @agentskit/adapters @agentskit/core @agentskit/runtime tsx
cp apps/docs-next/fixtures/provider-swap/agent.ts ./agent.ts
AGENT_PROVIDER=ollama npx tsx agent.ts
```

## Verified claims

- **agentskit/native-adapters**: 25 native adapters (from ecosystem-claims.json)
- **agentskit/catalog-providers**: 140 providers (from ecosystem-claims.json)

## Citations

- [provider-swap fixture](apps/docs-next/fixtures/provider-swap/agent.ts)
- [provider-swap recipe](/docs/reference/recipes/provider-swap)
- [OpenRouter free models router](https://openrouter.ai/docs/guides/routing/routers/free-router)

## Ecosystem next steps

- [AgentsKit](https://www.agentskit.io/docs) — Build agents without gluing many libraries together.
- [AgentsKit Registry](https://registry.agentskit.io/docs) — Copy ready-made agents and own the source.
- [AgentsKit Chat](https://chat.agentskit.io/docs) — Define one agent experience and deliver it across interfaces.
- [Agents Playbook](https://playbook.agentskit.io/docs) — Train coding agents to ship code your team would merge.
- [Doc Bridge](https://doc-bridge.agentskit.io/) — Turn repository documentation into executable agent handoffs.
- [AgentsKit Code Review](https://github.com/AgentsKit-io/code-review-cli#readme) — Run deep, low-noise review with the model already in use.
- [AgentsKit OS](https://akos.agentskit.io/docs) — Run and govern agents in production.
